title: Jeanne & Peter Lougheed Performing Arts Centre

services.name: Tasting
services.desc: Have a wee dram! ‘The Whisky Sessions’ is an interactive session hosted by Skerryvore band members that uses music to take the audience on a journey through Scotland’s famous whisky regions and distilleries. Audience members will sample 4 specially selected malt whiskies from Scotland’s Ardnahoe Distillery. A piece of music selected and performed to match each whisky, will accompany every ‘dram’ during the tasting. The band will also reflect on personal experiences and stories linked to each particular whisky and/or region, which further enhances the personal and intimate nature of this session. Let the Good Times Pour, or maybe even Sip
